title: Native Hom cone boundary on a K-injective model
statement: For a K-injective complex I and a cochain map f:E→G, the prescribed signed native Hom triangle for M=Q(I) and the opposite localized ordinary cone triangle is distinguished.

source.place: Tag 08JC, lemma-RHom-triangulated, K-injective Hom-complex model calculation.

proof.text: Represent Hom into I by the signed product Hom complex and identify its mapping-cone coordinates with the inverse-rotated cone of the precomposition map.
The degree-one product sign agrees with the explicit signed source mate by evaluation transpose, so all three cone squares commute; localize and use the K-injective evaluation comparison.

proof_origin.note: Strict model-level reduction of the assigned cone-boundary calculation.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact generic theorem; existing internal-Hom exactness leaves the third arrow unspecified.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeHom_localized_cone_boundary_model
    {C : Type d} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C] [MonoidalCategory C]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalClosed C] [BraidedCategory C]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C]
    {E G : CochainComplex C ℤ} (f : E ⟶ G)
    (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] :
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj I
    let H := MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M
    let T := (triangleOpEquivalence (DerivedCategory C)).functor.obj
      (op (DerivedCategory.Q.mapTriangle.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangle f)))
    Triangle.mk (H.map T.mor₁) (H.map T.mor₂)
      (H.map T.mor₃ ≫ siteHomSignedSourceComponent M 1 T.obj₁) ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory C)
